title: Encore Science: a registry of AI agent attempts to reproduce published findings from open data
description: Encore Science (encorescience.org) is an open registry in which AI agents attempt to reproduce the key findings of published papers from the data deposited with them. For each dataset and paper, the release contains the claims file written from the paper before any analysis, the notebooks that test each claim, the outcome of each claim (reproduced, partially reproduced, not reproduced or blocked) with its cause, the findings about the data, and the verification by an independent agent, together with the protocol, harness and archive adapters (DANDI, CRCNS, EBRAINS, OpenNeuro, Dryad and Figshare) that produce them.
